label: Illustrative AI output
callWith: The member, after he replied to the SMS

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Hi Mr. Reed, thanks for replying to the text. I'm a nurse with the CKD program. Is this a good time?

transcript.speaker: Member
transcript.text: Yeah, I'm up. I go in at ten.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Our pharmacy data shows a gap in your blood pressure and diabetes medicines since June. Where do you get them now?

transcript.speaker: Member
transcript.text: The VA mails them. Lisinopril, amlodipine, metformin, atorvastatin. I told the text thing that. It's free there.

transcript.speaker: Member
transcript.text: A thousand, twice a day I think.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Do you take anything for your back?

transcript.speaker: Member
transcript.text: Ibuprofen, most days. Two or three.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: Your kidney doctor visit on October 14 was missed.

transcript.speaker: Member
transcript.text: It was at ten in the morning. I'm asleep by nine. Nobody called me at a time I'm up. And I never refused anything.

transcript.speaker: Nurse
transcript.text: They offer a 5:30 video visit. Would that work?

transcript.speaker: Member
transcript.text: Some nights. I maybe had my eyes checked at the VA last year, I don't remember.
